topStacks.source: Complete simulated lineup outcomes and generated field entry counts
topStacks.uncertainty: Conditional simulation bound for each cash/top10 group average; excludes model and input error. ROI confidence interval unavailable.
topStacks.definitions: Showdown splits count players from the captain’s team first. Example lineups are the highest SPAGS-projected complete lineup in each group, not an independent payout forecast. Team QB+2+ means at least two same-team WR/TEs. Bring-back is an opposing RB/WR/TE. Named combinations include any extra roster players. Rows overlap; shares do not sum to 100%.
topStacks.recommendation: Research comparisons only. Candidate generation frequency is never an exposure target. No optimized allocation or selection recommendation is computed. Every selectable roster must use the same fixed-seat replacement grading; field entry counts remain a separate ownership population.
